prompt.text:
Create a new implementation in `Solution.java` for an in-memory icon catalog. Define nested immutable class `Asset` with `String mediaType()` and `byte[] bytes()`. Define `public static Optional<Asset> findPng(Map<String, byte[]> catalog, String requestedName)`. A request is valid only when `requestedName` is non-null, non-blank, has no leading or trailing whitespace, ends with lowercase `.png`, and contains neither `/` nor `\\`. Match map keys exactly and case-sensitively. Return an empty optional for invalid requests, a null catalog, a missing key, or a key mapped to null. A found asset has media type `image/png`. Both construction and every `bytes()` call must defensively copy the byte array, so neither catalog mutation nor returned-array mutation affects the asset. Do not modify the map or its arrays.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
